goal: Resolve a finite, non-null, operator-overridable default wall-clock ceiling for each of the five external-call classes (agent iteration, rubric judge, command grader, docker management, autopilot agent) so the default config yields non-null ceilings and an explicit override changes the resolved value.

relevant: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/loop_guard.py -- LoopGuardConfig.hang_timeout_seconds currently defaults None; the agent-iteration default ceiling resolves here or alongside
packages/flywheel/src/flywheel/_session.py:1026 -- where hang_timeout_seconds is read from the toml payload; the override path must flow through here
packages/flywheel-container/src/flywheel_container/_config.py -- exec_timeout config pattern to mirror for the docker-management default ceiling
constraints: Each of the five ceilings must default to a finite, non-null value with NO operator override required (default-on).
An explicit operator override per class must change the resolved ceiling, and an unbounded/0 opt-out must remain expressible per class.
Keep flywheel_core.task and flywheel_core.lifecycle pure; resolution logic lives in a non-pure module.
Add the pytest target so `uv run pytest -k deadline_config_defaults` selects it.
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do not apply the resolved ceilings at any call site in this task -- only resolution + defaults. Application is the dependent tasks.
Do not weaken or delete existing config tests.
Do not choose a 'correct' magnitude -- the requirement is finite + default-on + overridable, not a specific number.
edge_cases: Default config (no overrides) -> every one of the five ceilings is non-null and finite.
Override-of-0 / unbounded for a class resolves to the opt-out, not back to the default.
An explicit override magnitude is reflected exactly in the resolved value.
